title: Mixed Event — You deserve it! Break Time! — Episode4 For So Long, You've...

meta.Event Outline: As the livestreaming gains momentum, Haruka endeavors to create new content to keep viewers engaged. Balancing daily practice, training, school studies, and idol activities, Haruka devotes herself without a moment's rest, causing Shizuku to worry.

rows.Speaker: Members
rows.Line: Shizuku, congratulations on becoming the lead!

rows.Speaker: Members
rows.Line:
I can't believe it...
It hasn't even been six months since she joined Cheerful * Days and she's already the lead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everybody, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was very surprised to hear that I'd been chosen for this role too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I know that I'll have to keep doing my best to make sure our fans are happy with this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There may be some growing pains at first, but I'm hoping that we can work together to get through them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's keep making Cheerful * Days as exciting as it can be...!

rows.Speaker: Program director
rows.Line: Shizuku, we've been looking forward to seeing you again! Our ratings have been booming thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm just happy that everyone is enjoying this so much. Thank you for always having me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Today's talking points are about what I want to do as the lead of Cheerful * Days and the toughest parts of being an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The script even has what I'm supposed to say...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I'm Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days. It's an honor to be chosen as the group's lead.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I have you, the fans, to thank for allowing me to become the lead. I promise to do everything I can to make this group more fun and exciting.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “We'll be counting on your support.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This isn't me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I have to tell the fans and everyone else this, don't I...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to be the person they want me to be...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As long as I'm the lead for this group...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can I really handle this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
Did I startle you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...! K-Kiritani...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm Hinomori.
It's so nice to meet you...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm Haruka Kiritani.
It's nice to meet you too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It really is...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I never thought that we'd be on the same show together. I've been wanting to talk to you for some time now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, since you became your group's lead just after debuting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But the reason why I was given this role isn't because of any particular talents I have...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm really nothing special.
I'm just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I saw Cheerful * Days perform a little while ago and you were the one that I thought shined the brightest then, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It felt pretty clear that you're the one that works the hardest out of everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I think you were the obvious choice to become the lead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
H-Hinomori? What's wrong?
Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, it's just...
I'm a little scared is all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm wondering if it's really okay for me to be the lead...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I understand...
Cheerful * Days is a fairly large group, so being the lead does come with just that much responsibility.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm just so concerned...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Doesn't it ever bother you, Kiritani...?
All these expectations and all this pressure?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me? Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I try to stay focused on what I need to do as the leader of my group, and how to meet our fans' expectations. I'm not sure that I feel that pressure though...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
You're such a strong girl, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I'm really not. I just genuinely love being an idol is all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You love being an idol?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do. I've been enamored by them since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wanted to be just like them. I want to stand up on the stage and give hope to as many people as I can...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My goal is to keep doing that and I really enjoy all of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You really are amazing.
The best of the best. It's like you're shining even brighter in person than when I see you on TV...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to meet my fans' expectations too, but I'm not sure I can get myself to do what you do, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you can, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You thinking this hard about what you can do for your groupmates and fans means that you're trying your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being the lead means there will be added pressure and responsibilities compared to everybody else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll be just fine, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And please call me Haruka.
We're both idols after all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then... Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please call me Shizuku...
And let's keep doing everything we can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Haruka seemed like the perfect idol even back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even now... She works so hard with us behind the scenes when the cameras aren't rolling, and treats her fans so well too...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's the ideal idol that everyone wants...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It must be incredibly difficult to maintain that persona...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does she really always stay in character like that...?
